smells.description: Cycle Shop.Core.Orders -> Shop.Core.Billing -> Shop.Core.Orders: OrderService uses InvoiceService and Invoice, while Invoice and InvoiceService use Order.
Shop.Core.Billing (I = 2/3: depends on Orders and Common, used by Orders) depends on the less stable Shop.Core.Orders (I = 3/4: depends on Billing, Common and Customers, used by Billing).
Shop.Core.Common realizes three unrelated features whose classes do not use each other: e-mail sending [EmailSender, SmtpSettings], CSV export [CsvExporter, CsvOptions] and checksums [Crc32].

The audit-logging concern is realized separately in Clinic.App.Patients, Clinic.App.Appointments and Clinic.App.Reports, each of which is also responsible for its own concern (patient registration, booking, reporting).

Clinic.App.Integration offers a single, general entry point: MessageGateway.Handle(string command, object payload) dispatches on a command string, so its services (register, find, book) are hidden from its interface.
Geometry.Shapes contains 32 classes in a single component: IShape, RegularPolygon, 18 regular polygons and 12 other shapes.

Every component depends on every component below it (Api -> Orders -> Shipping -> Stock -> Pricing -> Data and all shortcuts): 15 dependencies among 6 components, average degree 5, so there is no layering.
